name: alen-androsevic
description: Claude Code skills by Alen Androsevic, each in its own repository

plugins.name: break-stuff
plugins.description: Drives a running web page or mobile app as a hostile user, tries to break it, and reports every break with repro steps and evidence

plugins.name: skat
plugins.description: Creates a new Claude Code skill through a few multiple-choice questions, grills the draft with grillmeister, and writes it as parts that skat builds into skills/<name>/

plugins.name: grillmeister
plugins.description: Grills a Claude Code skill draft: finds every gap a cold run would trip over and asks you about each one, one multiple-choice question at a time, then fixes the draft
